notes.title: Kestrel Launch Party!
notes.notes:
Kestrel, a shoot'em up game with a focus on progression through upgrades. Releasing on June 18th, 2021!  

Our friend McEpsilon will be streaming the launch party and playing the game at 7:00 PM MDT on release day. The developer will be joining in on the fun and answering any questions people may have.  For those of you who tune in, you may be able to win a free copy of the game!

McEpsilon's channel can be found here https://www.twitch.tv/epsilonlost. Be sure to give a follow and turn on notifications so you don't miss out on the event!
